Something reliable, comfortable you shoot well. 9mm kills plenty good. A gun you shoot well you can carry beats a gun left at home or in the car. Get in a lot of range time on different guns before you buy, if at all possible. I carry a G31, but most people can't pull it off.

If you like 1911 ergonomics then the sig p938 is a great choice but expensive. Assuming you carry onbthe waist, get a real gun belt and a good holster. A soft belt will make even a light gun uncomfortable.
The G26 is a great gun, but it can still be a chunk to carry. I'm going to switch to pocket carry with a smaller gun, as I honestly can't see myself hauling the G26 daily.
